BiblicalUsage: Thebez, also called Tebets, was a town where Abimelech died when a woman dropped a piece of millstone on his head from the tower. David later asks who smote Abimelech, saying, Did not a woman cast a piece of a millstone upon him from the wall, that he died in Thebez.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Thebez is remembered for one stone: the strong man died by a woman's hand, and David knew the story.
